medications.new_start_evidence: Velantine was selected as first-line antihypertensive given the patient's good renal function and absence of contraindications.
medications.source_quote: Velantine 10 mg PO once daily Continue indefinitely Hypertension

medications.new_start_evidence: Cordizem-XR was added for rate control of the atrial fibrillation.
medications.source_quote: Cordizem-XR 100 mg PO once daily Continue indefinitely Rate control, hypertension

medications.new_start_evidence: Pravoxil was prescribed for hyperlipidemia management given the patient's elevated LDL on admission labs.
medications.source_quote: Pravoxil 20 mg PO every morning Continue indefinitely Hyperlipidemia

medications.new_start_evidence: a short course of anxiolytic therapy was recommended.
medications.source_quote: Etrazolam 0.5 mg PO twice daily 8 weeks Acute anxiety, sleep disturbance
ambiguities: Psychiatry reassessment is stated as 'in two weeks' (p.3, p.5 follow-up) and 'at the 8-week mark' (p.5 counseling).

medications.timing_raw: at the same time each day
medications.new_start_evidence: Pranixol was added per cardiology recommendation for adjunctive cardiovascular protection.
medications.source_quote: Pranixol 10 mg PO once daily Continue indefinitely Adjunctive cardiovascular protection

medications.new_start_evidence: Quintaxin was added for GERD prophylaxis given the multi-drug regimen and the patient's reported intermittent heartburn.
medications.source_quote: Quintaxin 20 mg PO once daily, before breakfast 8 weeks, reassess GERD prophylaxis
